# visionary_alert_channel (Data Source)

Looks up a notification channel made outside Terraform, by name or id, so rules can send to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A channel made in the dashboard, used by a rule managed here.
data "visionary_alert_channel" "oncall" {
  name = "On-call Slack"
}

resource "visionary_alert_rule" "down" {
  name      = "Instance down"
  metric    = "instance_silent"
  op        = ">"
  threshold = 5
  channels  = [data.visionary_alert_channel.oncall.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Channel id; give this or name.
- `name` (String) Channel name; give this or id.

### Read-Only

- `digest_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the weekly digest goes here.
- `has_secret` (Boolean) Whether a secret is stored.
- `kind` (String) Channel kind.
- `url_masked` (String) The URL with its token hidden.
